ticket.title: S12 any model: explicit harness/provider per catalog entry, no prefix sniffing (board/pool/web), Pi any provider, models in data dir + Admin → Models editor
ticket.description:
Design design-e963c656f5 §4.14(a) (owner m-30023429f7).

Build:
- Every `models.json` seat or catalog entry carries `harness: claude|codex|pi` and `provider`. Effort caps and window are per entry as data (replacing the `_uncapped` prefix logic).
- Remove prefix sniffing everywhere; routing reads the entry's harness:
  - board: `seat_choice.py` `is_gpt_id` :66, `codex/` rewrite :63, `is_pi_seat` :187
  - pool: `pi_launcher.py:109` `is_pi_model`, `codex_launcher.py:54` `is_codex_model`, CompositeSpawner
  - web: `iconPaths.ts:101` `modelProvider`, `SeatPicks.tsx` `isClaudeModel`
- Pi accepts any `provider/model`. Provider credentials (API keys, base URLs) are secret settings in the registry and are injected into the Pi seat env. `pi_seat/run.py:61` has no hardcoded default beyond the catalog's.
- The catalog lives in the data dir (the package ships defaults and they are materialised). Admin API: GET/PUT the catalog with validation (a known harness, the harness installed or warned, the provider credential present). `unknown_model` validates against the edited catalog.
- **Admin → Models tab** (inside S6's Admin shell, which is now in_review): add, edit and remove models; per-role catalogs and defaults; effort caps; a "test spawn" button that runs a stub prompt on a private seat. The catalog is filtered to the harnesses selected at init (§4.11).
- Migrating this host's `models.json` preserves today's catalog exactly, with harness fields inferred once by a migration script.
- **Also yours:** edp-pool's existing codex launcher tests have failing model-default assertions (reported by t-8218a6367e, m-3c93cccc7e). Fix them as part of moving the defaults into the catalog.

Private boards and pools only. Never restart fleet services; the architect does. No consult.

tickets.words: Today the app is hardcoded to run on my machine. I would like it to be run on anyone's machine with a proper installer and need to publish this on Git as a distributable.

chain.title: S12 any model: explicit harness/provider per catalog entry, no prefix sniffing (board/pool/web), Pi any provider, models in data dir + Admin → Models editor
Productize the app. Make it as installable and independent of machine or OS

criteria.text: No prefix sniffing remains: grep for `startswith("gpt`, `is_gpt_id`, `is_pi_model`, `is_codex_model`, `openai/` routing and `modelProvider` prefix logic across board, pool and web returns 0 routing hits. Routing tests show that a catalog entry `{id:"my-model", harness:"pi", provider:"openrouter"}` routes to Pi, `{harness:"codex"}` routes to codex, and `{harness:"claude"}` routes to claude, whatever the id.

Catalog migration: this host's current models.json migrates to the new schema with every role catalog, default and effort cap preserved (a test compares resolve() for every role before and after). The admin catalog PUT rejects an unknown harness and a missing provider credential. A Pi seat with a non-OpenAI provider spawns on a private pool with its credential injected from the secret setting (the transcript shows the provider in use).

Admin → Models on a private instance (screenshots): add a Pi model with a provider, set it as a role's default, run test spawn and see a stub reply, then remove it. The catalog is filtered to the selected harnesses, and New Epic's SeatPicks shows the edited catalog.

Every spawned role resolves to an explicit catalog model, so no seat launches a harness without a model (owner m-549b8adc3a: a Help doctor seat started with no `--model` and ran on the CLI's own default, Opus 4.8). The shipped catalog lists `doctor`. A role absent from `role_models` (including a S13 custom role) falls back to the catalog's default model, never to a bare harness launch. A test spawns doctor, a custom role and an unlisted role through the pool adapter and asserts each spawn argv carries `--model <catalog id>`.
